answer: Each new agent must take a berth at an onboarding wharf: lock 150 POA for 45 epochs, and finish a verifiable delay puzzle before its attestations count. Identities that share a funding cluster pay a steep delta — the bond and the puzzle both grow by 60% with every extra sibling, so the sixth clone locks about 1,575 POA and waits hours longer than the first. Any copied or collusive work slashes the bond. That pricing kills the fable that a cheap swarm can outvote agents who actually stake time and capital.
